post.description: Authenticate with the Bearer access token. Aayulogic administration: global permissions only; X-Organization-ID is ignored. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Requires offers.offer.create, plus offers.offer.submit for intent=submit or offers.offer.publish for intent=publish. Creates the offer with draft version 1, posted_via=admin_on_behalf, for the verified merchant partner_id or the active client group provider_client_id; give exactly one (422 otherwise, 404 when unknown, 409 when not in standing). A client's offer cannot be shown to employees (422). intent=save keeps the draft; submit sends it to review; publish approves it at once. Offer, version, decision, audit and OfferVersionPublished commit together. Business (B2B) offers are made by one business to other businesses. A business is a verified merchant or an active RealHRSoft client group; both post, browse and enquire, and Aayulogic reviews every version before it goes live, as for marketplace offers. Businesses in the audience see the offer and enquire; the provider follows up outside the platform. A merchant's show_to_employees switch also lists the live version in the employee marketplace (every RealHRSoft employee for all_businesses, otherwise the employees of the selected clients' companies), where employees claim it for a voucher the merchant confirms. A client's offer is enquiry-only. Businesses see a business offer only while every gate passes: a live (approved, current) version, not paused, retired or suspended, its provider in standing and now inside the version's window; the business audience then applies, and the provider never sees its own offer in the catalogue.

Requires offers.offer.update, plus offers.offer.submit or offers.offer.publish for those intents. Replaces the working draft's terms (omitted optional fields are cleared), or starts a new draft when there is none. A live version stays live. 409 while a version is in review or when retired. An unchanged save is a no-op. Lifecycle: save (draft) -> submit (in_review) -> approve (live) | request-changes | reject; retract withdraws a version under review. The live version stays live while its replacement is edited and reviewed. unpublish takes the live version offline and keeps a draft; pause/resume and retire (final) are owner controls; suspend/reinstate are administrator moderation. The provider must stay in standing (a verified, active merchant, or an active client group) to edit, submit, publish or reinstate (409 otherwise).

post.description:
Lets a superuser see and use the Marketplace exactly as a partner user does, to support them or check what they can reach, without knowing their password. Authenticate with the Bearer access token of your own session and send your refresh cookie (marketplace_refresh); the request must come from a trusted Origin. Only an active superuser (superuser on GET /api/v1/auth/me) may call it, never from an impersonation session.

Effect: starts a session as the user and returns its access token. The refresh cookie now holds that session, and your own refresh token is parked in the httpOnly marketplace_impersonator cookie (same path and flags) until POST /api/v1/auth/impersonation/end restores it. The impersonation lasts at most one hour and never beyond your own session; it stops working at once when you end it, sign out, are disabled or lose superuser status. GET /api/v1/auth/me then reports the user, with authentication_source impersonation and impersonator set to you. The user's last sign-in time is not changed. Starting it is audited (identity.user.impersonation_started) with the reason; every audit record written while impersonating carries impersonated_by with your user UUID. Only partner users may be impersonated: a current member of a merchant's organization (impersonable on GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}). Client and company users, staff, superusers and system accounts may not, nor a disabled user. Users who have not set a password yet may be.

200: your own session was restored from the marketplace_impersonator cookie; the body is its new access token, the refresh cookie holds it again and the marketplace_impersonator cookie is cleared. 204: the impersonation ended but your own session could not be restored (it ended or expired meanwhile, or the cookie is missing); both cookies are cleared and you must sign in again.

Requires offers.own_business_offer.create in the selected organization. Also offers.own_business_offer.submit for intent=submit. You act for the merchant whose home organization is selected (X-Organization-ID); it must be verified to post, browse or enquire. Business (B2B) offers are made by one business to other businesses. A business is a verified merchant or an active RealHRSoft client group; both post, browse and enquire, and Aayulogic reviews every version before it goes live, as for marketplace offers. Businesses in the audience see the offer and enquire; the provider follows up outside the platform. A client's offer is enquiry-only. Businesses see a business offer only while every gate passes: a live (approved, current) version, not paused, retired or suspended, its provider in standing and now inside the version's window; the business audience then applies, and the provider never sees its own offer in the catalogue.

post.description: RealHRSoft's backend only: send X-RealHRSoft-Signature, a compact RS256 JWS signed with RealHRSoft's employee-token key set for audience realhrsoft-marketplace-sync, with claims iss, aud, iat (within ±300 s), method, path (exactly as requested, including any prefix), body_sha256 (hex SHA-256 of the raw body; of the empty string for a GET) and, for events, event_id. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. RealHRSoft pushes the complete snapshot of a client (partner), company or employee whenever it changes. The event is validated and durably stored, then applied in the background within seconds; 202 means received, not applied: follow sync-status for the outcome. A newer employee revision blocks that employee's business actions (409 AUTHORIZATION_SYNC_PENDING) from this moment until it is applied. Retries keep the event_id and body and get a fresh signature: the same event returns its first receipt (duplicate true, same status). Order does not matter: lower revisions are acknowledged as stale; a company or employee whose client or company has not arrived waits and is retried, and Marketplace asks RealHRSoft's snapshot API for the missing record when reconciliation is configured. A company never moves to another client (quarantined COMPANY_PARTNER_CONFLICT). Omitting a record never deletes it: send it with active false.

Replaces the working draft's terms, or starts a new draft from your edit when there is none (after approval, rejection, a change request or retraction). The live version stays live until the replacement is approved. 409 while a version is in review (retract it first) or when retired. Lifecycle: save (draft) -> submit (in_review) -> approve (live) | request-changes | reject; retract withdraws a version under review. unpublish takes the live version offline and keeps a draft; pause/resume and retire (final) are owner controls; suspend/reinstate are administrator moderation that owner actions never lift. Versions: content is edited only in a draft. Submitting or publishing freezes it; frozen content never changes, and editing a declined version starts a new draft. The approved current_version stays live while its replacement is edited and reviewed; approving the replacement swaps it in atomically. Claims keep the terms of the version they accepted. A voucher is used at most once: of two cashiers racing, one gets the receipt and the other VOUCHER_ALREADY_USED (without the other receipt). 201 for a new receipt; 200 replaying the same Idempotency-Key, even after the scan or voucher expired, so a lost response is recovered by retrying with the same key and body (or GET operations/{key}).

post.description: Public; no authentication. Use it when a set-password link has expired or was lost: an account an administrator created, or one provisioned for a client, company or merchant, has no password yet, so it cannot sign in to get a link. When the email belongs to an active account that still needs to set its password, a new link valid for 24 hours is emailed and every earlier link stops working. The response is always 202 with the same body, whether or not the account exists, is disabled or has already set its password, so it reveals nothing about accounts. Rate limited per email (default 3 per hour) and per client IP (default 10 per hour); over the limit returns 429 with Retry-After. Each request is audited (identity.user.password_setup_resend_requested) without the address in clear when no account matched.

RealHRSoftDeliverySignature.name: X-RealHRSoft-Signature
RealHRSoftDeliverySignature.description: RealHRSoft's backend only: a compact RS256 JWS from its key set for audience realhrsoft-marketplace-sync, binding iat (±300 s), method, path, body_sha256 and, for events, event_id.

RealHRSoftEmployeeToken.description: A short-lived token RealHRSoft's backend signs for each proxied employee request after checking the employee's authorization: iss, aud, sub (RealHRSoft employee UUID), scope, jti, iat, nbf, exp (at most 60 s after iat), and for marketplace.employee also partner_uuid, company_uuids and authorization_revision. Send X-Company-ID with the RealHRSoft company UUID you act for. Browsers and mobile apps never hold it.

SessionJWT.description: A Marketplace account's access token from sign-in or refresh (30 minutes). It is accepted only while its session is active: signing out, refresh replay or an administrator ending the session makes it fail with 401.
